goal.original: Bench-evaluate the LTX spatial upscaler as the SeedVR2 successor: does it reconstruct rather than sharpen, does it keep an eye an eye, and does it clear the 16 GB ceiling that killed MPI-506.
goal.summary: Three closures and a scope correction. (1) The positive prompt was ORDERING the skin speckles - confirmed by eye, fixed at source, re-baselined. (2) Sigma 0.50 PASSED the ship/no-ship watch and 0.85 STAYS on the slider as a user-chosen trade (Fabio corrected the card on that). (3) The detail transfer and its evidence gate are CLOSED NEGATIVE with a root cause. Then the bigger one: the card had benched a degraded phone clip when the real application is AI-generated footage. Fabio supplied both target clips; target 1 is measured with a recommended default, target 2 was mid-run at handoff.

completed: THE PROMPT WAS THE CAUSE. build_v2v.py conditioned every arm on '...natural skin texture, freckles, sharp eyes'. A/B at 25 frames (freckle control on disk + p_neutral + p_empty) and Fabio on PROMPT_cheek_f12.png: 'two moles, the model's attempt at doing freckles'. 0.85 STAYS ON THE SLIDER - the card had wrongly ruled it out. Identity replacement and object deletion are trades a user picks at the top of a denoise range; identity restoration via LoRAs is another flow's job, explicitly out of scope. Range ships 0.15-0.85

DETAIL TRANSFER + EVIDENCE GATE CLOSED NEGATIVE, root-caused. The op assumed the donor re-renders texture while leaving the performance alone; at 0.85 it regenerates expression, so it stamps one expression onto another - Fabio: 'eyes open and closed at the same time, like two frames fighting', face 'stamped on'. This also explains the gate's earlier unexplained 'expressions lost' verdict, so the temporal-smoothing test is DROPPED as a wrong hypothesis
TARGET 1 MEASURED - the sigma ladder on a low-res AI source (cowboys wagon, 864x480, 73 frames). RECOMMENDED DEFAULT sigmas 0.50, range 0.15-0.85. Awaiting Fabio's pick
LTX 2.5 RESEARCHED and MPI-578 created (todo/blocked) to adopt its upscalers after the ComfyUI bump. Fabio's call: v1 ships on 2.3

key_decisions: THE PRODUCT IS ONE SLIDER, `sigmas`, RANGE 0.15-0.85. No post-pass dial. Every post-processing control on this card is closed negative - detail transfer, evidence gate, split radius, luma-only, temporal upscaler. Do not revive any of them without new evidence; the reasons are properties of the method, not of a setting.

0.85 IS SELECTABLE, and the card was wrong to rule it out. Identity replacement and object deletion are trades the user picks; Fabio expects 0.85 to suit animation, cartoons and anime. Identity restoration via LoRAs is another flow's job and explicitly out of scope for the upscaler.

THE REAL SOURCE CLASS IS AI-GENERATED FOOTAGE, in two flavours: low-res generation needing a bump (target 1, measured) and a high-res finished generation going higher for delivery (target 2, mid-run). The degraded phone clip every earlier arm used is the HARD case, not the representative one - on the AI source 0.15-0.50 cluster tightly and 0.85 no longer replaces the person.

v1 SHIPS ON LTX 2.3. MPI-578 carries the 2.5 upscaler bump, blocked on the ComfyUI engine bump. The 2.5 DiffVAE may invalidate this card's swim finding in either direction - re-measure, do not carry the number over.

THE EYE BEATS THE INSTRUMENT ON THIS CARD, every time it has been tested. The detail transfer looked like a clean ladder on a still and was broken in motion; three high-pass measures could not see two moles. `Verify mode: user-ux` is load-bearing, not decoration.
